name: El Capitan (Krasnodar bouldering hall)
research_notes: Track C: located from the club's own site. The contacts page carries a map block with a per-hall coordinate for the bouldering hall (45.069276, 39.022007); the page also lists a separate kids' hall on ul. Baybakova 4 (not a bouldering gym, not proposed). The hall page shows a timetable valid from 1 Sept 2026, so it is current. A climbing club that also trains adults in the bouldering hall (routes about 4-4.5 m, mats); adult drop-in terms were not seen, hence category club. Not the St Petersburg El Capitan (ru-024).

name: Skala City
research_notes: Track C: located from the OSM node matched by name, website and street (Kutuzovsky 36 bldg 14). The own site describes a 12 m wall with 100+ routes and partner belaying (top rope) and publishes an offer contract dated 28 April 2026 and a phone, so it is operating. No bouldering mention anywhere on the page, so bouldering stays unknown (not confirmed rope-only); expect a blocked flag for the reviewer.
